_source.how: The bundle embeds two IDL object literals, keyed program_v0.json (testnet, EXB36Zz...) and program_v0_mainnet.json (mainnet). This is the mainnet one (variable WI, object literal at byte offset 1076194). It was converted from the JS literal to JSON by a parser that evaluates no code (template strings to strings, !0/!1 to true/false). Only this _source key was added.
_source.on_chain_check: Compared on 2026-11-12 with the Anchor IDL account 6k18rmC3pk2Yeqm26pW1FaEG4Z841s76HccshUFq76DB (createWithSeed(PDA([], program), "anchor:idl"), authority HjaGVTXA9az5iu8EdqNHZgm5c3FY3ohNGQZFhnjn28YK, slot 92670080). They are identical, ignoring key order and nulls, except metadata.name (on chain: x1_inscriptions) and metadata.description (on chain: "X1 Inscriptions: block maps (X1MAPS), inscriptions, X1-20 tokens and parcels on X1 mainnet").

instructions.name: add_version

inscribes the update and links it here. The version inscription is LOCKED to the original (its owner becomes
the VersionHead PDA), so it travels with the original when sold and can't be sold on its own.

version: ["artrule", version] holds the version, the sha256 of the published rule file and where it lives.

instructions.name: append

instructions.name: begin_release
docs: Step 1: pays the release fee (once, here) and moves the sealed manifest into the release PDA for good. Title,
type, price, supply and the market-fee cap are fixed here, exactly as create_release fixes them.

instructions.name: break_lot
docs: Break the lot back into the seller's available balance (closes the lot, rent back to seller).

instructions.name: bridge_in
docs: Real tokens → back into your X1-20 balance (burned on the token side), 1:1.

instructions.name: bridge_out
docs: X1-20 balance → real tokens in your wallet, 1:1 (whole tokens × 10^decimals base units).

instructions.name: buy_edition
docs: Buy a listed edition: 5% to the release's creator (skipped when they're the seller), 2% market fee, rest to the seller.

instructions.name: buy_inscription
docs: `max_price` guards against the seller raising the price while the buyer's tx is in flight.

instructions.name: buy_lot
docs: Buyer takes the WHOLE lot at its price (atomic). Lot rent goes back to the seller.

instructions.name: buy_parcel
docs: Buy a parcel: market fee, 2.5% to the parcel's creator, 2.5% to whoever holds the MAP right now (each skipped
when that person is the seller), the rest to the seller; the NFT (and anything filled into it) goes to the buyer.

accounts.name: map_owner
docs: account (the client passes the seller) and no map cut is paid

instructions.name: cancel_epoch_root
docs: Admin, only during the root's timelock: closes a wrong epoch root (rent to the admin) so the map authority can
post the right one; no map can have used it yet. Works while paused, like the other admin settings.

instructions.name: cancel_inscription_listing
docs: Cancel: the inscription goes back to the seller (listing closed, rent back).

instructions.name: check_voter
docs: Anyone: a listed wallet under the line loses its vote (no ban: it can vote again once it's back).

instructions.name: claim_artist_proof
docs: ARTIST'S PROOF (owner 10-26): the release's creator gets ONE free copy, once, minted to their own wallet and
SOULBOUND — permanently frozen, so it can never be sent, listed or sold anywhere; the owner can still burn it
(PermanentBurnDelegate, authority Owner). Doesn't use a numbered slot. A movable copy = buy a real edition.

instructions.name: claim_district
docs: Claim a REGULAR block (genesis blocks 0–121 go through claim_genesis_district). Counts toward the claimer's
regular-claim counter ["claims", wallet] (GENESIS CLAIM RULE: 8 of these before a genesis map).

accounts.name: claims
docs: the claimer's regular-claim counter (GENESIS CLAIM RULE), created on their first claim

instructions.name: claim_genesis_district
docs: GENESIS CLAIM (owner 10-27 / 10-29): a genesis block (0–121) — only by a wallet that claimed 8 regular maps itself,
ONE per wallet ever (["genesis_of", wallet] is created here), at the admin's genesis price INSTEAD of the claim
fee (max_fee guarded). The map joins the genesis pool at once (["gshare", d] snapshots the pool's counter).

accounts.name: config
docs: mut since 11-10: the genesis ladder counts each claim in the config (appended at GENESIS_CLAIMED_AT)

accounts.name: genesis_of
docs: ONE genesis map per wallet: created here, so a second genesis claim by the same wallet fails

accounts.name: share
docs: the map's genesis-share record (joins the pool now)

instructions.name: claim_genesis_share
docs: CLAIM a genesis map's share: whoever HOLDS the map NFT now gets everything owed since the last claim (earnings
belong to the map: claim before you sell, or the buyer gets what's waiting). Nothing owed = nothing happens.
Paid from the pool PDA, which always keeps its rent. Several maps = several of these in one transaction.

instructions.name: collect_tax
docs: AUTOMATIC TAX COLLECTION (owner 10-28), PERMISSIONLESS: Token-2022 keeps a tax token's tax WITHHELD inside each
recipient's token account. Anyone (our keeper, the receiver, a holder) passes token accounts of this ticker's mint
as remaining_accounts (writable): their withheld tax is harvested into the mint, then everything withheld in the
mint is withdrawn — signed by the bridge PDA, the mint's withdraw authority — straight into the stored tax
receiver's token account (created if missing; the caller pays its rent). The caller can't send it anywhere else.
Tokens bridged before this (authority = the receiver's wallet) are refused (TaxNotCollectable): the receiver
withdraws those directly as before. Nothing withheld = nothing moves (harmless).

accounts.name: config
docs: THE config (pinned address, cheap); refused while paused

instructions.name: commit_epoch
docs: EPOCH COMMITMENT (Theo 10-23): the map authority anchors one Merkle root over every block map of an epoch
(MERKLE RULE v3, audit 10-28: leaf = sha256(0x00 ‖ height u64 LE ‖ map length u32 LE ‖ sha256(map bytes)), dense:
every height from..=to, in order). Write-once: anyone can later prove a map never changed.
v3 roots live at ["commit2", epoch] (the old ["commit", epoch] v2 roots are never read again: their leaf didn't
bind the length, so a stranger could begin a real map with a wrong length and brick it).

accounts.name: commit
docs: v3 roots (leaf binds the map length): ["commit2", epoch]

instructions.name: create_parcel
docs: The map's holder splits it: parcel n (1..=squares of the map BAKED on chain) becomes its own NFT
`<n>.<d>.x1map`, minted to them. Fee = the parcel fee (extra_fees). Created parcels stay with whoever holds them, whatever
happens to the map; the map's holder can create the ones that don't exist yet.

instructions.name: create_release
docs: Create a release from a sealed manifest inscription + up to MAX_RELEASE_ITEMS sealed file inscriptions the creator
holds. remaining_accounts = the item inscriptions, then their NFTs, in the same order. All of them (and the
manifest) move into the release PDA FOREVER. Mints the MASTER NFT to the release PDA, permanently frozen.

instructions.name: deploy_launch
docs: Launchpad mode: optional per token, chosen at deploy, never after. See LAUNCHPAD_DESIGN.md.

accounts.name: home_district
docs: Required only when deploying onto a home district.

instructions.name: describe
docs: Optional title + description for an inscription. Set ONCE (the record can't be re-created) by the creator, or
by its upload key (writer) during a one-approval upload, so it never needs an extra wallet popup.

accounts.name: config
docs: THE config (pinned address, cheap); every user action is refused while paused (audit 10-28)

instructions.name: drop_burned_genesis
docs: PERMISSIONLESS (owner 10-30): a joined genesis map whose NFT was BURNED can never claim again, so it leaves the
pool: the record closes (rent to the caller) and what it was owed (the full counter gap, sub-lamport part included)
is shared by the maps still joined, or goes to the treasury when none is left. Moving the map's own gap can't
break the pool: acc_per_map grows by floor(gap / joined), so the others gain at most what this map gives up.
That money was counted in total_in when it came in, so it isn't counted again.

instructions.name: enable_bridge
docs: Creates the ticker's real token (Token-2022: name, symbol, decimals, metadata link). Mint authority = this
program's bridge account, so tokens only ever exist 1:1 against locked X1-20 balances.
TAX TOKEN (owner 10-25; audit 10-28): optional, fixed by the deployer in set_bridge_policy BEFORE the first mint
(stored in TokenMeta ["meta", tick]; none stored = 0%) — taken by Token-2022 on every transfer of the real token,
harvested by anyone with collect_tax straight to the stored receiver (owner 10-28). The caller can't choose it. The rate can NEVER be changed afterwards (no
fee-config authority), so buyers know it for good.

instructions.name: fill_parcel
docs: WRITE-ONCE: the parcel's holder puts an inscription they hold into an EMPTY parcel. The inscription's NFT moves
into the parcel PDA forever (it travels with the parcel, can't be sold apart); a filled parcel never changes.

accounts.name: config
docs: THE config (pinned address, cheap); every user action is refused while paused (audit 10-28)

instructions.name: final_count
docs: Final count: ONE atomic transaction reads all 33 Balance records (remaining_accounts, in list order). All 33
must be at or over the line at the same instant, so tokens are never frozen (owner 11-02). Needs an address lookup table for the size.

instructions.name: finish_release
docs: Step 3: turns the draft into the real Release and mints the MASTER, as create_release does. The draft closes, so
this works once. Takes no fee and no fee guard: it must never be stoppable by a fee change after the files moved in.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: GRADUATE: anyone, once minted out or once the vote passed. One transaction: real mint, reserved tokens (scaled to the
minted share), bridge open, xDEX pool from the vault's XNT, LP burned. The vault pays every cost; the caller pays only the
transaction fee and gets what's left after the costs (closed helper accounts, the unused margin).

accounts.name: mint
docs: xDEX pool + vault addresses and send them dust, and xDEX initialize then fails forever (harness C09). So: caller's random nonce.

instructions.name: init_edition_collection
docs: Admin, once: the "X1 Editions" Core collection (masters + editions).

instructions.name: init_genesis_pool
docs: Admin, once: create the genesis pool PDA (rent-exempt from the start; it never holds a private key). Until it
exists every genesis share goes to the treasury (feeds treat a missing pool as "no genesis map joined").

instructions.name: init_nft_collections
docs: Admin, once: create the two collections (inscriptions, land). Their update authority is our ["nftauth"] PDA,
so only this program can mint into them: a "verified" X1 Inscriptions / X1MAPS NFT can't be faked.

instructions.name: init_parcel_collection
docs: Admin, once: the "X1MAPS Parcels" Core collection (same update-authority PDA as the other two).

instructions.name: inscribe
docs: Creates inscription #config.next_inscription with the first chunk. Sealed at once if the chunk is everything.
The creator (main wallet) owns it from the start. `writer` = a throwaway key the browser makes so the rest of
a big file uploads without more wallet popups; it can ONLY append to this one inscription. None = creator.
`encoding`: 0 = raw bytes, 1 = gzip (the site compresses before upload; viewers decompress).

accounts.name: inscription
docs: Allocated for the header + the first chunk only; `append` grows it.

accounts.name: genesis_pool
docs: APPENDED LAST (owner 11-10) so every account before it keeps its index for anything that reads them positionally.

instructions.name: inscribe_big
docs: Starts a big inscription: header only; content arrives via `write_chunk` into part accounts, in any order.

accounts.name: genesis_pool
docs: APPENDED LAST (owner 11-10) so every account before it keeps its index for anything that reads them positionally.

instructions.name: launch_vote
docs: Stalled token: a wallet with at least 0.30% of supply joins the list. The first vote checks the door (90 days since
launch, latching it for good, and >= 50% minted, re-checked every vote). `evict` = a list index whose wallet has fallen under the line: it is
replaced in the same instruction (its Balance = remaining_accounts[0]), so a list stuffed with empty wallets can't lock anyone out.

instructions.name: map_begin_proved
docs: CLAIMER PAYS (owner 10-23): ANYONE may bake a block's map — paying its rent — once its epoch is committed.
The map's sha256 must sit at index (district - from) of that epoch's Merkle root, so only the map our indexer
drew can be written, and once sealed it never changes (no owner, buyer or admin can redraw it on mainnet).
An empty block (no value moved) is baked as a 0-byte map. Big maps continue with map_write_open; only the
account that began a map may continue it (a stranger can't spoil a half-written map), stored after the bytes.
AUDIT 10-28: the leaf binds the map's LENGTH too (rule v3, roots at ["commit2", epoch]), and a map that was begun
but never sealed (wrong bytes, abandoned) can be reset with map_reset_unsealed — nobody can brick a block's map.

accounts.name: commit
docs: only a v3 root (["commit2", epoch]) proves a map: its leaf binds the map's length

accounts.name: config
docs: THE config (pinned address, cheap); every user action is refused while paused (audit 10-28)

instructions.name: map_reset_unsealed
docs: AUDIT 10-28 (anti-brick): close a proved map that was begun but NEVER SEALED, so the true map can be baked again
(map_begin_proved — it can go in the SAME transaction). Its writer may do it any time; ANYONE may once
MAP_ABANDON_SLOTS (~1 day) have passed since it was begun. The rent always goes back to the recorded writer.
Sealed maps can never be reset (on mainnet a sealed map is forever).

accounts.name: caller
docs: the writer (any time) or anyone (once MAP_ABANDON_SLOTS have passed since the map was begun)

accounts.name: config
docs: THE config (pinned address, cheap); every user action is refused while paused (audit 10-28)

instructions.name: map_write
docs: Append the next bytes; seals (and checks the sha256) when the last byte lands. Write-once.

accounts.name: authority

instructions.name: map_write_open
docs: Continue a map begun with map_begin_proved: only the account that began it. Sealed (hash checked) at the end.

instructions.name: rescue_claim
docs: After rescue_open: burns the caller's free balance for its share of the vault, paid to the caller only. No bar, no config:
a pause can't hold this money.

instructions.name: rescue_open
docs: Anyone, ONE transaction: reads all 33 Balance records (remaining_accounts, in list order). All 33 must be at or over the line
at the same instant, so one stack passed around can't fill it. Ends the launch for good and fixes the share (pot / supply),
so claim order changes nothing.

instructions.name: rescue_request
docs: RESCUE (owner 11-02): a token that became ready (mint-out or vote passed) and still has no pool LAUNCH_RESCUE_SLOTS later.
A wallet with at least 0.30% of supply joins the rescue list. `evict` works as in launch_vote. No config: a pause can't hold this money.

instructions.name: set_bridge_policy
docs: Bridge rule: 1 deployer turns it on, 2 opens by itself `auto_days` after mint-out (0 = at mint-out), 3 never.
Deployer only, and only before the first mint (holders know the rule before they mint).
TAX (audit 10-28): the real token's transfer tax is fixed HERE too — `tax_bps` (0 = none, max 1,000 = 10%) paid to
`tax_receiver` — under the same lock, stored in TokenMeta. enable_bridge uses only these stored values (a token
that never set them bridges with 0% tax), so neither a stranger opening an 'auto' bridge nor the deployer after
people minted can choose the tax.

accounts.name: meta
docs: holds the bridge tax (audit 10-28)

accounts.name: config

instructions.name: set_extra_fees
docs: EXTRA FEES (owner 10-28): the parcel, release and bridge fees, admin-changeable like the others (each ≤ 200 XNT).
Stored as 3 × u64 right AFTER the Config record in the same account, so the Config struct (and every existing
config, e.g. testnet's) still decodes; the first call grows the account by 24 bytes (admin pays the rent).
Until it is called, the built-in defaults apply. Admin only; works while paused (like update_config).

instructions.name: set_genesis_settings
docs: GENESIS SETTINGS (owner 10-29): the genesis pool's share (bps) of the X1-20 mint fee, the X1-20 launch fee (deploy
fee or short-ticker premium) and the market fee, and the genesis claim price (charged INSTEAD of the claim fee).
Stored after the extra fees (grows the config by 14 bytes the first time, writing the extra-fee defaults too if
set_extra_fees never ran). Admin only; works while paused. Shares ≤ 100%, price ≤ 200 XNT.

instructions.name: set_map_authority
docs: Admin names the key allowed to write district maps (the indexer). Can be changed; written maps never change.

instructions.name: set_site
docs: Point a district at its website: `home` and each page are sealed text/html inscriptions the land owner owns.
remaining_accounts = the inscription accounts, home first, then the pages in order. Replaces any earlier site.

accounts.name: config

instructions.name: set_site_name
docs: SITE NAME (owner 10-25: "the site name instead of a number"): <name>.x1ins.xyz → this inscription (and its newest
version). Holder of the original's NFT only; first come, first served; one name per inscription and one
inscription per name, for good — the name goes with the inscription when it's sold. Priced like tickers:
1/2/3 characters = premium[0..3], longer = fees.deploy (admin can change both).

instructions.name: set_token_home
docs: TOKEN HOME IN A PARCEL (owner 10-28): makes a token's home REAL space on its map. Deployer only, once. The token's
home label must be map `district`; parcel n of it must be filled with the token's DEPLOY RECORD — a sealed,
raw (one-account) inscription of type HOME_RECORD_TYPE that the deployer created, whose JSON names this ticker
and this home — and the deployer must hold the parcel's NFT. That NFT then moves into the token's TokenMeta PDA
FOREVER (no instruction can ever move it out: the home can't be sold apart from the token), and TokenMeta
records parcel n + the record's number. Old label-only tokens can do this later the same way.

accounts.name: meta
docs: records the home; holds the parcel's NFT forever

accounts.name: inscription

instructions.name: thaw_inscription
docs: FREEZE UNFINISHED (audit 10-28): an inscription's NFT minted before its last chunk landed carries a FreezeDelegate
{frozen} held by our ["nftauth"] PDA, so nobody can sell or move it (direct Core transfer, outside markets) while
its writer key can still add bytes. Once it is SEALED anyone may call this: it unfreezes the NFT and REVOKES our
authority over that plugin (back to the owner), so the program keeps no power over the holder's NFT. Nothing to do (not ours / done) = no-op.

types.name: ArtRule
docs: Parcel n of map d (PDA ["parcel", d, n u32]); its NFT is the Core asset PDA ["nft_p", d, n]. `content` = the
inscription filled into it (write-once; that inscription's NFT is held by this PDA forever).
The published art rule, anchored on chain (write-once per version)

fields.name: locked
docs: DEPRECATED 10-22 (lots are escrow now: tokens leave the balance). Old testnet lots may still show here.

types.name: BridgeState
docs: Bridge settings + state per ticker. `bridged` = whole tokens currently living on the Token-2022 side.

types.name: ClaimCount
docs: Regular maps a wallet claimed itself (["claims", wallet])

fields.name: name
docs: the token's human name, up to MAX_NAME printable ASCII characters; "" = derive it from the ticker

fields.name: wallet_cap
docs: max mints per wallet, 0 = no cap

fields.name: mint_price
docs: lamports per mint paid to the deployer, 0 = free

fields.name: start_district
docs: minting opens at this district (0 = now)

fields.name: home
docs: district the token lives on; caller must own it

types.name: EpochCommit
docs: One epoch's Merkle root over its block maps. PDA ["commit2", epoch u32] (v3 roots). `slot` starts the ROOT_DELAY_SLOTS timelock.

fields.name: premium
docs: deploy fee for 1, 2, 3-character tickers: charged INSTEAD of `deploy` (0 = the base fee)

fields.name: market_bps
docs: marketplace fee in basis points (max 10%)

types.name: GenesisDropped
docs: owed = lamports the burned map was owed; to_treasury = what left the pool (0 when the maps still joined share it)

types.name: GenesisOf
docs: The one genesis map a wallet claimed (["genesis_of", wallet])

types.name: GenesisPool
docs: GENESIS EARNINGS pool (["genesis_pool"], pinned GENESIS_POOL_ADDR): holds the shares fed in (plus its rent).
acc_per_map = lamports per joined genesis map so far × GENESIS_SCALE. Field order is read by offset in feed().

types.name: GenesisShare
docs: A joined genesis map (["gshare", d]): owed = (pool.acc_per_map − snapshot) / GENESIS_SCALE

types.name: InsName
docs: reverse: inscription → its one name. PDA ["insname", root].

types.name: Inscription
docs: Header; the raw content bytes follow it in the same account (HEADER .. HEADER + total_size).

fields.name: encoding
docs: 0 raw, 1 gzip

fields.name: writer
docs: only key allowed to append (creator, or a one-upload throwaway key)

types.name: InscriptionMeta
docs: Title + description of an inscription (optional, permanent once written).

fields.name: eligible_slot
docs: slot the token became ready (mint-out or vote passed). Set once, nothing moves it.

fields.name: launch_slot
docs: deploy slot: the vote clock counts from here, nothing moves it.

fields.name: name
docs: the token's human name, up to MAX_NAME printable ASCII characters; "" = derive it from the ticker

types.name: Listed
docs: kind: 0 inscription, 1 district, 2 lot. price 0 = unlisted.

types.name: Listing
docs: Escrow for a listed inscription (kind 0) or district (kind 1): while it exists, the item's owner IS this PDA.

fields.name: price
docs: lamports for the whole lot, 0 = not listed

types.name: MapAuthority
docs: Who may write district maps (the indexer key).

types.name: Origin
docs: A map's original creator (its first claimer): paid the creator royalty on every resale. PDA ["origin", d].

types.name: Part
docs: One piece of a big inscription: up to PART_CHUNKS chunks; `mask` = which chunks have landed. Bytes follow the header.

types.name: Release
docs: A release (owner 10-26): keyed by its manifest inscription; the manifest + its files are held by this PDA forever.

fields.name: kind
docs: RELEASE_KINDS index: music, video, writing, art, audio, access

fields.name: price
docs: per edition, lamports (0 = free)

fields.name: max_supply
docs: 0 = open edition

types.name: ReleaseDraft
docs: A release being built (owner 10-30): ["rel_draft", manifest], from begin_release until finish_release closes it.

fields.name: max_fee_bps
docs: the market-fee cap the creator agreed to at begin_release

types.name: RoyaltyPaid
docs: EARNINGS LEDGER (owner 10-28): a royalty / creator cut actually paid. kind = listing kind (0 ins, 1 map, 2 parcel,
3 edition), id = the listing id (ins number, map number, d*100000+n, manifest*1000000+k), price = the sale price.

types.name: Site
docs: A district's website. Served at <district>.x1inscriptions.io only while `owner` still owns the district
(and the record is closed on every transfer/sale anyway).

fields.name: code
docs: owner ticked "my page uses JavaScript": visitors see a warning first

types.name: SiteName
docs: <name>.x1ins.xyz → inscription. PDA ["name", name bytes].

fields.name: name
docs: the token's human name, set once at deploy (owner 11-10). Empty = the bridge keeps deriving "TICK (X1-20)".

types.name: TokenMeta
docs: Extra per-token settings, kept apart from Token so tokens deployed before it existed keep working.

fields.name: logo
docs: inscription number of the logo image

fields.name: tax_bps
docs: bridge TAX (audit 10-28), fixed by the deployer in set_bridge_policy before the first mint: basis points (0 = none)

fields.name: tax_receiver
docs: who collects the tax (default key when tax_bps = 0)

fields.name: home_n
docs: TOKEN HOME IN A PARCEL (owner 10-28): parcel n of the token's home map that holds its deploy record (0 = none,
parcels start at 1). Set once by set_token_home; the parcel's NFT is then held by THIS account forever.

fields.name: home_ins
docs: the deploy-record inscription filled into that parcel (valid when home_n > 0)

fields.name: reserved
docs: room for later switches without a migration (was 64 bytes; 34 hold the tax, 12 the home: same account size +
layout, existing accounts read as 0% tax and no parcel home)

types.name: VersionHead
docs: Versions of an inscription: how many and which is newest. PDA ["vhead", root].

types.name: VersionLink
docs: One version: PDA ["ver", root, index u32] → the inscription holding that version (index 1 = first update).
